description: A rear extension together with a part first-floor, part two-storey side extension, a partial garage conversion and a new porch, significantly enlarging a home in Benfleet.

caseStudy.text: The Fishers wanted to substantially enlarge their home at 38 Perry Road, Benfleet.
caseStudy.heading: The Brief

caseStudy.text: The design combines a rear extension with a part first-floor, part two-storey side extension, a partial garage conversion, and a new porch.
caseStudy.heading: The Approach

caseStudy.text: Castle Point Borough Council granted full planning permission for the scheme.
